import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver import Version

# Test m1 requirements
print("Test 1: is_valid with Arabic-Indic digit")
result = Version.is_valid('1\u0662.2.3')
print(f"  Version.is_valid('1\\u0662.2.3') = {result}")

print("\nTest 2: is_valid with trailing newline")
result = Version.is_valid('1.2.3\n')
print(f"  Version.is_valid('1.2.3\\n') = {result}")

print("\nTest 3: parse valid version")
try:
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3')
    print(f"  Version.parse('1.2.3') = {v}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  ERROR: {e}")

print("\nTest 4: parse with Arabic-Indic digit")
try:
    v = Version.parse('1\u0662.2.3')
    print(f"  Version.parse('1\\u0662.2.3') = {v} (should have raised)")
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"  Correctly raised ValueError: {e}")
